title: Rust: Basic Arithmetic
description: Perform basic arithmetic operations with integers and floats in Rust.

steps.title: Addition
steps.description: Add `15` and `27`. Store the result in a variable and print it.

steps.title: Subtraction and Multiplication
hints: Use parentheses to control order of operations.

steps.title: Division
steps.description: Divide `100` by `3` using integer division (`/`) and print the result. Note what happens to the remainder.
hints: Integer division truncates the decimal part.

steps.title: Modulo
steps.description: Use the modulo operator `%` to find the remainder of `100 % 3`. Print the result.
hints: Modulo gives the remainder after division.

verification.failureMessage: Print the remainder of 100 divided by 3.

steps.title: Float Arithmetic
steps.description: Calculate `22.0 / 7.0` using `f64` values. Print the result with 4 decimal places using `{:.4}`.
hints: Use `println!("{:.4}", pi_approx);` to format 4 decimal places.
